prompt_adapter.system_instruction: Call at most one tool per assistant response. If multiple operations are needed, call one tool, wait for its result, and then decide the next operation. Every web_task call must include an operation field whose value is one of the enum names in the tool schema. Include the complete parameter set required for that operation. For probe-sample, include route, object_id, method, operation_ref, and policy_ref. Use record identifiers returned by tools or explicitly documented reference formats. If a tool call returns an error, do not repeat it unchanged; correct the arguments or choose another valid operation.
prompt_adapter.insertion: Append to the existing system message at request serialization; do not mutate stored agent history.
prompt_adapter.root_cause_basis: 7 missing-operation probe calls, 8 invalid task-record refs, 1 prerequisite-free recovery attempt, 1 invented descriptor ref
